---
title: "Treatment Ranking"
---

```{r}
source("R/nma_functions.R")
dat <- load_pairwise_data()
nm <- run_model(dat, model_type = "simple", effect_model = "random")
```

## P-score ranking

```{r}
ranking <- tryCatch(extract_ranking(nm, effect_model = "random"), error = identity)
if (inherits(ranking, "error")) {
  cat("Ranking failed:", conditionMessage(ranking))
} else {
  knitr::kable(ranking)
}
```
